verdict.rationale: First-party marketing says DGX B200 targets LLM workloads and claims 15X inference performance over the previous generation, and the system ships Docker Engine and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit. That is only a generic inference claim, not a documented inference stack: nothing in the pack covers FP8 or FP4 precision or names a supported serving framework. Missing for 10: FP8/FP4 low-precision format documentation, TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp (or other serving stack) support documentation for B200, independent or hands-on inference corroboration.
